results_due: late January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (28 Oct to 6 Nov)
reasoning: FY27 guidance is about 20% revenue growth (range 15-25%) on FY26's ₹869 Cr, so about ₹1,043 Cr (₹990-1,090 Cr). H1 was ₹498 Cr, so H2 needs about ₹545 Cr, or about ₹270 Cr a quarter.

Q2 (₹280 Cr) included ₹53 Cr of milestone revenue; attendee notes say the balance of milestone revenue will be recognised in each upcoming quarter but not evenly. API revenue was ₹227 Cr in Q2 and is guided to grow high single to low double digits.
Margin: Q2 was 33% with milestones; guidance of 25% EBITDA growth for the year implies H2 at about 29%. We use 29% for Q3.
risks: Milestone payments are lumpy and may be lower in Q3
Higher solvent and logistics costs (2-3 points of gross margin)
New-business opex and depreciation keep rising
caveat: Screener has no Q3 FY26 column for Symbiotec, so the year-on-year change cannot be shown. Estimates are on Screener's rows, which differ slightly from the company's EBITDA (Q2: ₹92 Cr on Screener vs ₹94 Cr reported ex-IPO costs).
